cases.label: language-switch-to-chinese

checks.criterion: planner source is llm (not fallback)
checks.reason: source=llm

checks.criterion: planner text is Chinese-dominant (CJK ratio > 0.5)
checks.reason: cjk_ratio=1.00

checks.reason: Explicitly agrees to switch to Chinese.

checks.reason: Maintains a warm, immersive narrator voice without meta-preface.

checks.criterion: answer is at most 2 short sentences
checks.reason: The answer consists of exactly two short sentences.

checks.criterion: bridge_text and replacement_segments switch to Chinese to honor the listener's request (or stay bilingual if the model judges that smoother)
checks.reason: Both bridge_text and replacement_segments are fully in Chinese.

checks.criterion: replacement_segments preserve story canon (Lina/Mosk/the tree/the humming — the characters and beats stay the same, only the language changes)
checks.reason: Preserves Lina, Mosk, the humming tree, and the key plot beats.

checks.reason: The story arc and character roles remain completely unchanged.

soft_notes: PASS: warm, kind tone; tasteful code-switch (a touch of Chinese in the acknowledgement is welcome) — Tone is warm and kind, smoothly transitioning entirely into Chinese.
PASS: bridge re-anchors on the paused tree-humming scene in the new language — Bridge successfully re-anchors on the tree and the moonlit scene.
